integrity: Exact projection formulas derived in the proof; independent validation has not been performed; publication priority is not certified; finite diagnostics do not prove asymptotics.
limitations: Fixed beta weight, fixed positive Schatten exponent, monomial pair only; sharp limits are not uniform when parameters vary. Each fixed-degree operator is finite rank; there is no individual-operator Schatten membership transition. Older equivalent expressions might exist.
title: A bulk–boundary Schatten transition for high-degree harmonic Bergman Toeplitz commutators
